scaling_parameter.name: num_atoms
scaling_parameter.description: Number of atoms to place randomly for electrostatic potential computation

grid_size.description: Dimension of the 3D potential grid (grid_size^3 total points)

cutoff_distance_x10.description: Cutoff distance multiplied by 10 (integer representation, e.g. 12 = 1.2 Angstroms)

block_size.description: Thread block size for kernel launches
